entities.name: Armix
entities.description: Experimental filigree golem of Alara made entirely of new etherium by Breya; loyal but brutal and reckless.

entities.name: Conflux
entities.description: Event that merged the shards of Alara into a single plane.

entities.name: Esper
entities.description: Shard of Alara lacking materials for new etherium.

entities.name: Breya
entities.description: Human researcher of Esper who led an expedition into Jund and created Armix.

entities.name: Carmot
entities.description: Red stone, the missing ingredient for new etherium.

entities.name: Noble Work
entities.description: Esper's endeavor that needed etherium to continue.

events.summary: Breya leads an expedition into Jund and returns with carmot.
events.quote: She led an expedition into Jund and returned with carmot

events.summary: Breya creates Armix, a golem made entirely of new etherium.
events.quote: she created Armix, an experimental golem made entirely of brand-new etherium

events.summary: Armix becomes violent and unpredictable; Breya decides it is time for her own Noble Work.

relations.note: She built it to test her hypothesis.
